title: Luna: compact transition feedback
description: Existing versus compact motion receipts. Same Luna/high, tools, planner, two native cameras, eight anchored episode memories, 600 controls and 1800 seconds. No inherited task memory. Recorded probes preserve identical image manifests.
scope: Predeclared paired development pilot: three new state IDs across three task families, one episode per format and state. These IDs were absent from 106 indexed study manifests/configurations; this is not a claim of unseen objects or statistically established generalization. Only executed-receipt presentation differs. Offline judgments measure direction/contact interpretation; live trials measure task success, tool calls and total time.
